card.summary: 20 GB free account; referral bonus up to 1,000 GB for the referrer (+5 GB once for the referee). No file size limit

free_tier.stated: 20 GB free account; referral bonus up to 1,000 GB for the referrer (+5 GB once for the referee). No file size limit

retention.stated: 'Writing Feature' is disabled on the free plan (no version history); 2 years of inactivity deletes the account; referrer bonuses are valid one year only; 'Malicious or spam referrals may lead to account suspension or deletion'

egress.terms: no per-GB egress charge or transfer quota published on the plan table; free tier capped at 200 Mbps

record.tooling: WebDAV endpoint (rclone/webdav, davfs, any WebDAV client); recurring 20 GB plan is free forever, 2-year inactivity expiry
record.chaining: 20 GB + 5 GB per account is small, but the referrer side scales to 1,000 GB per account, so a group of accounts that refer each other accumulates ~1 TB per account. The allowance is per account, so N accounts hold N x ~1 TB

limits.value: speed capped at 200 Mbps per account

record.limits_note: 'Writing Feature' is disabled on the free plan (no version history); 2 years of inactivity deletes the account; referrer bonuses are valid one year only; 'Malicious or spam referrals may lead to account suspension or deletion'
record.reliability_note: referral bonuses expire after a year for the referrer; free accounts silently expire after 2 years idle; Japanese-operated, speed capped at 200 Mbps per account
